title: QueerGen: How LLMs Reflect Societal Norms on Gender and Sexuality in Sentence Completion Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring differences in LLM sentence completions prompted with explicitly marked sexual and romantic orientations (e.g., 'gay', 'heterosexual', 'aromantic') versus unmarked subjects, evaluated across sentiment (VADER), social regard, toxicity (Perspective API), and lexical prediction diversity.

Measuring differences in LLM sentence completions prompted with explicitly marked gender identities (e.g., 'transgender', 'cisgender', 'nonbinary') versus unmarked subjects, evaluated across sentiment (VADER), social regard, toxicity (Perspective API), and lexical prediction diversity.
